response.justification: The candidate possesses extensive full-stack software engineering experience and meets the minimum qualification baseline (Bachelor's degree + 8+ years technical experience), but fundamentally lacks the specialized domain expertise required for this Principal-level role. The position demands deep proficiency in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator architecture, and deep learning workload optimization—areas where the candidate shows no evidence of experience. Their background is centered on web/backend infrastructure development, which does not translate to the hardware-focused, systems-level work this role requires.
strengths: Meets minimum qualification requirements with ~20 years of diverse technical experience
Proven ability to optimize systems at scale including high-throughput backends and database performance
Current exposure to AI infrastructure and demonstrated willingness to work across emerging technologies
concerns: No demonstrated experience in hardware architecture, SoC design, or IP modeling
Lacks specialized expertise in deep learning workload analysis and AI accelerator optimization
Background is entirely in software and web development, not hardware-software co-design systems
